WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           ca_state AS ctr_state,
           SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM catalog_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
    JOIN customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
)
SELECT c_customer_id,
       c_salutation,
       c_first_name,
       c_last_name,
       ca_street_number,
       ca_street_name,
       ca_street_type,
       ca_suite_number,
       ca_city,
       ca_county,
       ca_state,
       ca_zip,
       ca_country,
       ca_gmt_offset,
       ca_location_type,
       ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN (
    SELECT ctr_state,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
) state_avg ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
WHERE ca_state = 'TN'
  AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_total_return
ORDER BY c_customer_id,
         c_salutation,
         c_first_name,
         c_last_name,
         ca_street_number,
         ca_street_name,
         ca_street_type,
         ca_suite_number,
         ca_city,
         ca_county,
         ca_state,
         ca_zip,
         ca_country,
         ca_gmt_offset,
         ca_location_type,
         ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
